title: Suguya: A Multilingual Advertising and Services Platform for Burkina Faso
excerpt: Suguya is a multilingual digital classifieds platform that connects individuals and businesses in Burkina Faso across categories such as real estate, vehicles, new and used goods, job listings, and local services. The platform is being developed to meet the needs of the local market through its web, mobile, and admin panel infrastructure.
content:
About the Project and the System’s Capabilities

Suguya is a multilingual classifieds, products, and services platform developed in Burkina Faso. The project’s primary goal is to bring together individual users, businesses, service providers, job seekers, and product sellers on a single digital platform.

The system is being developed with careful consideration of Burkina Faso’s local usage habits, mobile device penetration, linguistic diversity, and regional payment methods. Suguya is not just a traditional classifieds site; it is an integrated digital marketplace infrastructure that combines user, listing, messaging, notification, moderation, business account, and admin panel components.

Key Features of the System

Multi-Category Classifieds Infrastructure

On the platform, users can create listings in the following main categories:

  • Real estate for sale and rent
  • Cars, motorcycles, and other vehicles
  • New and used products
  • Job listings and job seeker profiles
  • Repair, transportation, cleaning, and local services
  • Ads for individuals and businesses

Each category is managed with its own fields for brand, model, location, price, product condition, and technical specifications.

Multilingual User Experience

Suguya was developed with a multilingual infrastructure to reach diverse user groups.

The platform is designed to support content and interface in languages such as French, English, Turkish, Arabic, Mòoré, and Dioula/Jula. The language system is not limited to the translation of static text; category, feature, country, and city data can also be managed in multiple languages.

Local Location and Search System

Users can filter listings based on the following criteria:

  • Country
  • City
  • District or neighborhood
  • Category
  • Price range
  • Product condition
  • Brand and model
  • Listing date
  • Individual or business seller

The location-based system is designed to help users find products and services near them more quickly.

Individual and Business Accounts

The system features different account and listing structures for individual users and businesses.

Individual users can post listings within the specified listing limits. Business accounts, on the other hand, are designed to allow users to take advantage of more posting rights, a business profile, advanced communication options, and features to make their listings stand out.

Communication and Messaging

Various options are available for communicating with the listing owner:

  • Phone
  • WhatsApp
  • In-platform messaging
  • Notification system
  • SMS verification

The platform is based on the principle that users determine payment and delivery terms directly among themselves.

Favorites and Saved Listings

Users can add listings they’re interested in to their favorites, save specific filters, and receive notifications about new listings that match their criteria.

This structure helps users revisit the platform and find the products or services they’re looking for more quickly.

Currency and Regional Structure

The platform’s base currency is the West African CFA Franc (XOF). Other currencies, such as the EUR and USD, can be supported as needed.

A centralized exchange rate infrastructure is being developed to record exchange rates daily and display listing prices according to the selected currency.

Administration and Moderation Panel

Suguya has a separate administration panel. The following actions can be performed through the administration panel:

  • User management
  • Approving and rejecting listings
  • Complaint and report management
  • Category and feature management
  • Country and city data management
  • Individual and corporate account controls
  • Ad space management
  • Review of system and synchronization logs
  • Monitoring of the main system and beta environment

Security and Verification

A phone and SMS-based verification infrastructure is used to verify user accounts. Moderation mechanisms are in place to report suspicious ads, forward them to administrative review, and remove them from publication when necessary.

Technical Architecture

Suguya is being developed with a scalable software architecture that can be adapted to different countries.

Core technologies:

  • Next.js and React-based user interface
  • Type-safe software development with TypeScript
  • Node.js-based server-side processing
  • PostgreSQL database
  • Prisma ORM data access layer
  • Docker-based container architecture
  • Server and publishing management via Coolify
  • Separate environments for the main system, beta, and admin panel
  • REST API-based service connections
  • SMS and notification services

The main system, beta environment, and admin panel are separate from one another. A central synchronization mechanism is being developed to ensure the controlled transfer of shared country, city, and category data between environments.

The Project’s Target Market

Suguya’s initial target market is Burkina Faso. The platform’s technical architecture is designed to allow for expansion into Niger and other West African countries in the future.

The following data can be managed separately for each new country:

  • Language
  • Currency
  • Country and city structure
  • Category tree
  • Local communication methods
  • Payment options
  • Legal Notices
  • Advertising and Subscription Models

Revenue Model

In the platform’s initial phase, we plan to implement an ad-supported model focused on increasing the number of users and the volume of listings.

In subsequent phases, the goal is to implement the following revenue models:

  • Corporate membership packages
  • Ad Promotion
  • Homepage and category ads
  • Featured listings
  • Additional listing packages
  • Business Profiles
  • Regional ad spaces
  • Transaction or service fees

Project Status: In Development and Deployment

Suguya’s web platform, admin panel, database structure, and core ad infrastructure have been developed. Improvements are ongoing regarding the user experience on the platform, mobile compatibility, category structures, moderation mechanisms, and notification services.

Testing and store submission processes are underway for the release of the Android mobile app on Google Play.

Explore the Platform

You can explore Suguya’s user interface, category structure, and listing system via the link below.

title: ANKAVERSE Nexus
content:
ANKAVERSE Nexus

ANKAVERSE Nexus is a multi-agent, AI-powered operations system that manages internal company operations based on logic involving targets, tasks, approvals, and outputs. The system operates through a structure comprising CEO, director, and worker agents and aims to manage corporate processes from a single central hub.

This structure is not merely a text-generating AI solution. It analyzes corporate goals, breaks them down into operational components, creates task flows, links critical operations to human approval, and makes processes measurable. This establishes a controllable and sustainable business model within the company, rather than uncontrolled automation.

Core Structure

Within ANKAVERSE Nexus, different roles operate with specific responsibilities. The CEO agent manages overall goals, priorities, and the approval mechanism. The Director layer generates recommendations in areas such as growth, content, commerce, and operations. Worker agents, meanwhile, carry out sub-operations such as research, reporting, content creation, and task execution.

Operating Logic

The system first analyzes the defined goal. It then generates recommendations, tasks, and priorities for that goal. Processes involving risk or requiring external action are controlled using an “approval-first” approach. Approved tasks are added to the queue system, processed by the worker layer, and the results are transferred to the dashboard. This ensures an end-to-end operational workflow extending from the goal to the task and from the task to the output.

Key Features

  • CEO, director, and worker agent architecture
  • "Approval-first" security and control structure
  • Centralized dashboard for task, proposal, and process tracking
  • KPIs, audit logs, and operational visibility
  • Deployment infrastructure based on Coolify, Docker, and GitHub
  • Modular architecture suitable for enterprise-scale expansion

Use Cases

ANKAVERSE Nexus is designed for use in areas such as e-commerce management, digital product development, advertising and content operations, research processes, proposal generation, and workflow automation. The goal is to consolidate dispersed workloads within the company under a single control and decision-making mechanism.

The system delivers particular value in corporate structures that require human approval. This creates an AI-supported operational model that preserves human decision-making, rather than relying on a fully autonomous and uncontrolled structure.

Conclusion

ANKAVERSE Nexus positions artificial intelligence not merely as a support tool, but as an operational layer that strengthens corporate processes. Management, task allocation, oversight, and output generation are integrated within the same system. This approach enables companies to operate in a more organized, faster, and more measurable manner.

title: Ankaverse Hub: AI-Powered Integrated E-Commerce Management
excerpt: Ankaverse Hub is an end-to-end operational system that aggregates products sourced from XML, Excel, and APIs into a single hub, enriches them with Artificial Intelligence, and transfers them to marketplaces, while also allowing you to manage orders and customer inquiries from a single dashboard. This autonomous system, which reduces manual workload by 95%, is currently in the development phase and aims to provide businesses with speed and efficiency.
content:
About the Project & System Capabilities
Ankaverse Hub is a next-generation, AI-powered Integration and Operations Hub that consolidates dispersed e-commerce data and operational processes into a single hub.

The system goes beyond simply processing raw data (XML/Excel/API) from suppliers and making it available for sale; it also aggregates orders from marketplaces and customer inquiries within the same dashboard, allowing you to manage the entire e-commerce process without switching between screens.

🚀 Key Features of the System

  • 📦 Integrated Order Management:
    Single-Screen Control: Consolidates orders from different channels—such as Trendyol, Hepsiburada, and N11—into a single pool. Automated Shipping Process: Automatically generates the order invoice, prints the shipping barcode, and integrates with the shipping carrier to provide real-time package status updates.
  • 💬 Customer Relations & Q&A Panel:
    Centralized Messaging: Consolidates customer questions from different platforms into a single “Inbox.” AI Assistant Responses: Artificial Intelligence analyzes customer questions, suggests the most appropriate response to the operator, or automatically answers frequently asked questions (e.g., “Where is my package?”).
  • 🌐 Platform-Independent Data Processing (PIM):
    Universal Import: Reads and standardizes all supplier data regardless of format—XML, Excel (XLSX/CSV), or JSON API. Dynamic Mapping: Allows you to map supplier data to database fields using a drag-and-drop interface, without requiring any coding knowledge.
  • 🧠 AI-Powered Content & Categories:
    Smart Content: Optimizes product names and descriptions for SEO. Auto-Categorization: Automatically matches source categories with marketplace categories (using NLP technology) with 99% accuracy.
  • ⚡ Autonomous Inventory and Pricing Engine:
    Real-Time Tracking: Immediately removes products from sale when they are out of stock at the supplier and instantly reflects cost changes in the selling price.

🚧 Project Status: In Development (Beta)

Ankaverse Hub is currently in active development and testing to shape the future of e-commerce. The system architecture is complete, and real-environment testing (UAT) with pilot users is ongoing.
